why: Drops the cap check, so a board with more than 64 live shells writes dash matrices past the fixed InstancedMesh buffer. Issue #688 requires the treatment not to buy readability with unbounded growth; the cap is where that bound is enforced, and without it the overflow is an out-of-range write rather than a quietly shortened trail.
killedBy: shell bounce-trail system (issue #688) is bounded: a fixed buffer, one object, and later shells dropped past the cap
